title: Remove unused location permission from Info.plist
description: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription is declared in Info.plist ('locality for games') but the app does not use location services anywhere. Apple will reject the app for declaring unused permissions. Remove NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription from Info.plist.

title: Add privacy policy for App Store submission
description: App Store requires a privacy policy URL since the app sends data to Supabase (game sync) and uses third-party APIs (RAWG). Create and host a privacy policy page documenting: what data is collected (game lists, seen games), where it's sent (Supabase, RAWG), no tracking/analytics, no personal data beyond game preferences. Host on GitHub Pages or similar.

title: Add sync user_id to settings screen
description: Display the current sync user_id on the settings screen so the user can see/copy their ID. This ID is used for Supabase sync and will be needed for the sync restriction feature.

title: Prepare App Store Connect metadata
description: Prepare all required App Store Connect metadata for submission: app description, keywords, category (Games/Entertainment), screenshots (6.7-inch and 6.5-inch minimum), support URL, age rating questionnaire answers. Consider promotional text and what's new section.

title: Move Supabase secrets to env vars / build-time config
description: Remove hardcoded Supabase URL and anon key from secrets.ts. Move to environment variables or build-time injection (e.g. react-native-config). Also move the HotUpdater baseURL from App.tsx to config. Ensure secrets are not visible in the compiled binary.

title: Tighten Supabase RLS policies
description: Current RLS policies are ALLOW ALL (no auth checks). Anyone with the anon key can read/write all data. Update policies on games, seen_games, and sync_metadata tables to restrict access by user_id. At minimum, filter all SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to match an allowed user_id list.

title: Restrict sync to authorized user_id only
description: Lock down Supabase sync so it only works for a specific authorized user_id. Update RLS policies in Supabase to reject requests from unauthorized user_ids. Add client-side gate to skip sync for non-matching users. This ensures only Tim's phone can sync data even if someone reverse-engineers the anon key.

title: Wrap console logs in __DEV__ checks
description: Multiple console.log/console.error calls exist in production code paths: supabaseSync.ts, seenGamesSync.ts, rawgApi.ts, migrateDuplicates.ts, App.tsx. These log user IDs, device IDs, and sync counts. Wrap all production logging in __DEV__ checks or use a logger utility that no-ops in Release builds.

title: Add RAWG API key onboarding flow
description: Create a first-time user screen flow where users bring their own RAWG API key. Show instructions on how to get a key from rawg.io/apidocs and why it's needed (game search/details). Store the key locally in AsyncStorage. Gate the app behind this screen until a key is provided. Remove the hardcoded RAWG key from secrets.ts.
